---
title: "LRSomatic — per-sample genomics report"
date: today
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    toc-location: left
    theme: [flatly, ../assets/styles/report.scss]
    code-fold: true
    page-layout: full
params:
  sample_id:     "SAMPLE"
  sample_dir:    ""
  reference:     "t2t"
  sex:           "female"
  default_panels: "__all__" # panel keys checked on load; "__all__" = none checked
  all_panels:    NULL   # named list from load_all_gene_panels()
  title:         "LRSomatic Report"
  repo_dir:      "."
  outputs:       NULL   # named list from locate_outputs()
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
  library(DT)
  library(htmltools)
  library(ggplot2)
})

repo_dir = params$repo_dir
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/utils.R"))
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/references.R"))
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/locate_outputs.R"))
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/parse_smallvariants.R"))
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/parse_severus.R"))
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/parse_ascat.R"))
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/parse_qc.R"))
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/circos.R"))
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/circos_bnd.R"))

source(file.path(repo_dir, "R/sections.R"))
for (f in list.files(file.path(repo_dir, "R/sections"), pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)) {
  source(f)
}

outputs = params$outputs
sample_id = params$sample_id
sample_dir = params$sample_dir

# Section-module contract: each registered section owns its own file
# discovery (locate) and parsing (parse). See CLAUDE.md.
SECTION_DATA = list()
for (s in SECTIONS) {
  SECTION_DATA[[s$id]] = s$parse(s$locate(sample_dir, sample_id), SECTION_DATA)
}

# Load reference data
cytobands    = load_cytobands(params$reference, file.path(repo_dir, "assets"))
chrom_lens   = load_chrom_lengths(params$reference, file.path(repo_dir, "assets"))
chromosomes  = chromosomes_for_sex(params$sex)
chromosomes  = chromosomes[chromosomes %in% unique(cytobands$chrom)]

# Load the gene panels checked on load (an empty list when --gene-panel none, i.e. no
# filtering). Several can be active at once and they union. Only the "Panel
# variants"/"Panel SVs" summary cards use them — the tables themselves are built
# unfiltered and filtered client-side.
#
# Deliberately not wrapped in tryCatch: a panel that can't be resolved, or whose
# declared reference is not the one being rendered against, has to fail the render
# rather than produce a report whose filter silently matches nothing (or matches the
# wrong genome's coordinates).
panels      = resolve_selected_panels(params$default_panels, params$all_panels,
                                      file.path(repo_dir, "assets"), params$reference)
panel_genes = unique(unlist(lapply(panels, `[[`, "genes"), use.names = FALSE))

# Parse ASCAT
ascat_segments = parse_ascat_segments(outputs$ascat_segments)
ascat_pp       = parse_ascat_purityploidy(outputs$ascat_purityploidy)

# Parse Wakhan
wakhan_solutions = parse_wakhan_solutions(outputs$wakhan_solutions)
wakhan_cn_plots  = locate_wakhan_cn_plots(outputs$wakhan_dir, wakhan_solutions)

# Parse QC
qc_mosdepth = parse_mosdepth_summary(outputs$mosdepth_summary, names(chrom_lens))
qc_mosdist  = parse_mosdepth_dist(outputs$mosdepth_dist)
qc_cramino  = parse_cramino(outputs$cramino)
qc_flagstat = parse_flagstat(outputs$flagstat)
samtools_stats = parse_samtools_stats(outputs$samtools_stats)
qc_normal_mosdepth = parse_mosdepth_summary(outputs$normal_mosdepth_summary, names(chrom_lens))
qc_normal_cramino  = parse_cramino(outputs$normal_cramino)
qc_normal_flagstat = parse_flagstat(outputs$normal_flagstat)
qc_normal_samtools_stats = parse_samtools_stats(outputs$normal_samtools_stats)

# Parse VEP + raw callers
vep_data = parse_vep(outputs$vep_somatic)

vaf_data = parse_caller_vcf(outputs$somatic_vaf_vcf, "somatic", sample_id = params$sample_id)

# Where the VAF/DP/GT/PS columns came from, for the footnote under the variant table. One
# file supplies them for every variant, which is ambiguous after a consensus merge — see
# templates/sections/_smallvariants.qmd.
vaf_prov = vaf_provenance(outputs$somatic_vaf_vcf, sample_dir, sample_id = params$sample_id)

variant_table = build_variant_table(vep_data, vaf_data, gene_panel = NULL)
tmb_info = compute_tmb(variant_table)

# Join coverage: a silently failing variant_key() shows up here as a near-zero count
# rather than as an error (see the variant_key() note in CLAUDE.md).
n_vaf = if (!is.null(variant_table) && "vaf" %in% names(variant_table))
          sum(!is.na(variant_table$vaf)) else NA_integer_
# Variants reported by more than one caller: `callers` collapses to "clairs,deepsomatic".
# Always 0 on the VEP text path, which carries no per-variant caller at all.
n_multi = if (!is.null(variant_table) && "callers" %in% names(variant_table))
            sum(grepl(",", variant_table$callers, fixed = TRUE)) else 0L

# SNV data for circos (from VEP file — contains all somatic variants)
snv_circos = NULL
if (!is.null(vep_data) && nrow(vep_data) > 0) {
  snv_circos = unique(vep_data[, .(chrom, pos, ref, alt)])
}

# Draw circos to temp file, then embed as base64
circos_tmp = tempfile(fileext = ".svg")
tryCatch({
  draw_circos(
    snv_data    = snv_circos,
    sv_nontrans = SECTION_DATA$sv$circos$nontrans,
    sv_trans    = SECTION_DATA$sv$circos$translocations,
    cnv_data    = ascat_segments,
    cytobands   = cytobands,
    chrom_lengths = chrom_lens,
    chromosomes = chromosomes,
    output_path = circos_tmp
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Circos plot failed: ", e$message)
  circos_tmp <<- NULL
})

# Summary counts
sv_table = SECTION_DATA$sv$table
n_snv        = if (!is.null(vep_data)) nrow(unique(vep_data[, .(chrom, pos, ref, alt)])) else NA_integer_
# One rearrangement, one row: Severus writes both sides of a breakend as separate
# records, and parse_severus_somatic_records() has already collapsed them.
n_sv         = if (!is.null(sv_table) && nrow(sv_table) > 0) nrow(sv_table) else
               if (!is.null(SECTION_DATA$sv))
                 nrow(SECTION_DATA$sv$circos$nontrans) +
                 nrow(SECTION_DATA$sv$circos$translocations) else NA_integer_
# Interchromosomal breakends, reported apart from the intra-chromosomal ones (which
# are mostly foldbacks, and which the old count filed under "translocations").
n_trans      = if (!is.null(sv_table) && "svclass" %in% names(sv_table))
                 sum(sv_table$svclass == "translocation", na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_
n_intra_bnd  = if (!is.null(sv_table) && "svclass" %in% names(sv_table))
                 sum(sv_table$svclass == "intra-chr breakend", na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_
# No panel checked on load → the panel cards have nothing to count, so they read
# "N/A" rather than a "0" that looks like "no panel genes hit". With several panels
# checked the counts are the union, matching what the browser shows.
have_panel   = length(panels) > 0 && length(panel_genes) > 0
n_panel_vars = if (!have_panel) NA_integer_ else
               if (!is.null(variant_table))
                 sum(variant_table$symbol %in% panel_genes, na.rm = TRUE) else 0L
# Same test, same windows as the client-side filter — sv_panel_hits() is the one
# implementation both call, so the card and the filter cannot drift.
sv_panel_hit = if (!is.null(sv_table) && nrow(sv_table) > 0)
                 sv_panel_hits(sv_table, panels) else character(0)
n_panel_svs  = if (!have_panel) NA_integer_ else sum(nzchar(sv_panel_hit))
```

```{r panel-js-data, results='asis'}
all_p = if (!is.null(params$all_panels) && length(params$all_panels) > 0)
          params$all_panels else list()

# Each panel ships both forms: the symbol set (small variants always match on symbols,
# and a symbol-only panel matches SVs that way too) and, for a coordinate-carrying
# panel, its intervals. The two windows come from R (SV_PANEL_WINDOW_* in
# R/parse_severus.R) rather than being written out again here, so the "Panel SVs" card
# and this filter cannot drift apart.
panel_defs = vapply(names(all_p), function(nm) {
  p    = all_p[[nm]]
  syms = paste0("new Set([",
                paste(js_quote(toupper(as.character(p$genes))), collapse = ","), "])")
  ivs  = if (isTRUE(p$has_coords))
    paste0("[", paste(sprintf("[%s,%s,%s,%s]",
                              js_quote(p$chrom), as.integer(p$start), as.integer(p$end),
                              js_quote(toupper(as.character(p$interval_gene)))),
                      collapse = ","), "]")
  else "[]"
  sprintf("%s: {symbols: %s, hasCoords: %s, intervals: %s}",
          js_quote(nm), syms, if (isTRUE(p$has_coords)) "true" else "false", ivs)
}, character(1))

cat("<script>\n")
cat("const GENE_PANELS = {", paste(panel_defs, collapse = ",\n"), "};\n", sep = "")
default_panels = setdiff(as.character(unlist(params$default_panels)), "__all__")
# js_vec() rather than paste(collapse=","): an empty selection has to emit [], and
# pasting an empty vector inside brackets yields [""] — one panel named "", which is
# the unfiltered state only by accident.
cat("const DEFAULT_PANELS = ", js_vec(default_panels), ";\n", sep = "")
cat("const SV_PANEL_WINDOW_BND = ",   format(SV_PANEL_WINDOW_BND,   scientific = FALSE), ";\n", sep = "")
cat("const SV_PANEL_WINDOW_OTHER = ", format(SV_PANEL_WINDOW_OTHER, scientific = FALSE), ";\n", sep = "")
cat("const BND_SVTYPES = [", paste(js_quote(BND_SVTYPES), collapse = ","), "];\n", sep = "")
cat(r"----(
// Checked panels, shared by the filter hook, the row counter, the panel_hit column's
// renderer and the SV footnote. Each table publishes its own column-name -> index map
// (window.SV_COLS / window.SNV_COLS) from R, so nothing here has to re-derive
// column positions from the rendered header: DT's filter row and Scroller's cloned
// thead both break that, and the failure mode is a filter that silently passes
// every row.
//
// An empty `panels` is the unfiltered state — there is no "__all__" entry in the UI,
// because "no boxes ticked" says the same thing without a sentinel to keep in sync.
window.svPanelState = { panels: DEFAULT_PANELS.slice(), customGenes: new Set() };

// Every checked panel, as {name, symbols, hasCoords, intervals}. A row passes if it
// hits any of them (union), which is what makes ticking a second box widen the view
// rather than narrow it.
function activePanelDefs() {
  const st = window.svPanelState;
  const out = [];
  (st.panels || []).forEach(function (key) {
    if (key === "__custom__") {
      // Pasted symbols carry no coordinates, so the custom panel is symbol-only. An
      // empty box contributes nothing rather than filtering everything out — under
      // union semantics that is the only reading that leaves the other panels alone.
      if (st.customGenes && st.customGenes.size > 0)
        out.push({ name: "custom", symbols: st.customGenes, hasCoords: false, intervals: [] });
      return;
    }
    const p = GENE_PANELS[key];
    if (p) out.push({ name: key, symbols: p.symbols, hasCoords: p.hasCoords, intervals: p.intervals });
  });
  return out;
}

function splitGenes(cell) {
  if (cell === null || cell === undefined) return [];
  return String(cell).toUpperCase().split(/[;,]+/)
    .map(function (g) { return g.trim(); })
    .filter(function (g) { return g.length > 0; });
}

// fmt_bp() from R/utils.R. Math.round(x * 10) / 10 rather than toFixed(1) because R
// prints the rounded number, not a fixed number of decimals: 188531 reads "188.5 kb" in
// both, but toFixed would turn a round 306000 into "306.0 kb" where R writes "306 kb".
function fmtBp(x) {
  const r = function (v) { return String(Math.round(v * 10) / 10); };
  if (Math.abs(x) >= 1e6) return r(x / 1e6) + " Mb";
  if (Math.abs(x) >= 1e3) return r(x / 1e3) + " kb";
  return String(x) + " bp";
}

// Panel genes an SV row hits, as "GENE (side, how)" labels — `how` being "direct" when
// the locus overlaps the gene, or the distance to it when it only fell inside the window.
// Mirrors sv_panel_hits() in R/parse_severus.R: a coordinate panel matches within
// SV_PANEL_WINDOW_BND of either breakend of a BND, or within SV_PANEL_WINDOW_OTHER of the
// span of any other type; a symbol-only panel matches the per-side VEP symbols directly.
//
// With more than one panel checked each label gains a " [name]" suffix naming the panel
// it matched, since with a union that is the only thing distinguishing two hits on the
// same gene. With one panel the labels are unchanged — R applies the same rule.
function svPanelHits(row, cols) {
  const defs = activePanelDefs();
  if (!defs.length) return [];
  const tagged = defs.length > 1;
  const out = [];
  defs.forEach(function (p) {
    const tag = tagged ? " [" + p.name + "]" : "";
    onePanelHits(row, cols, p).forEach(function (lab) {
      if (out.indexOf(lab + tag) < 0) out.push(lab + tag);
    });
  });
  return out;
}

function onePanelHits(row, cols, p) {
  const at = function (n) { return (cols && cols[n] !== undefined) ? row[cols[n]] : undefined; };

  if (!p.hasCoords) {
    // A VEP symbol sits on the breakend itself, so a symbol hit is always direct.
    const out = [];
    [["gene_a", "A"], ["gene_b", "B"]].forEach(function (side) {
      const hit = splitGenes(at(side[0])).filter(function (g) { return p.symbols.has(g); });
      if (hit.length) out.push(hit.join(",") + " (" + side[1] + ", direct)");
    });
    return out;
  }

  const isBnd = BND_SVTYPES.indexOf(String(at("svtype"))) >= 0;
  const ca = at("chrom_a"), cb = at("chrom_b");
  const pa = Number(at("pos_a")), pb = Number(at("pos_b"));
  // [chrom, windowStart, windowEnd, side, locusLo, locusHi] — the last two are the
  // unpadded locus, which is what the distance is measured from.
  const q = [];
  if (isBnd) {
    if (ca && isFinite(pa)) q.push([ca, pa - SV_PANEL_WINDOW_BND, pa + SV_PANEL_WINDOW_BND, "A", pa, pa]);
    if (cb && isFinite(pb)) q.push([cb, pb - SV_PANEL_WINDOW_BND, pb + SV_PANEL_WINDOW_BND, "B", pb, pb]);
  } else if (ca && isFinite(pa)) {
    const lo = isFinite(pb) ? Math.min(pa, pb) : pa;
    const hi = isFinite(pb) ? Math.max(pa, pb) : pa;
    q.push([ca, lo - SV_PANEL_WINDOW_OTHER, hi + SV_PANEL_WINDOW_OTHER, "span", lo, hi]);
  }

  const out = [];
  p.intervals.forEach(function (iv) {
    q.forEach(function (w) {
      if (iv[0] === w[0] && iv[1] <= w[2] && iv[2] >= w[1]) {
        const gap = Math.max(0, iv[1] - w[5], w[4] - iv[2]);
        const label = iv[3] + " (" + w[3] + ", " + (gap === 0 ? "direct" : fmtBp(gap)) + ")";
        if (out.indexOf(label) < 0) out.push(label);
      }
    });
  });
  return out;
}

// Small variants match on gene symbol in both panel modes: VEP annotates SNVs
// reliably, and per-gene symbols are the right semantics there.
function snvPanelHit(symbolCell) {
  const defs = activePanelDefs();
  if (!defs.length) return true;
  const genes = splitGenes(symbolCell);
  return defs.some(function (p) {
    return genes.some(function (g) { return p.symbols.has(g); });
  });
}

window.activePanelDefs = activePanelDefs;
window.svPanelHits     = svPanelHits;
window.svPanelHitLabel = function (row, cols) { return svPanelHits(row, cols).join(", "); };
window.snvPanelHit     = snvPanelHit;
)----")
cat("</script>\n")
```

*Report generated `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")` · LRSomatic report v1.3.0*

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  // Panel state, the matching predicates and the column-index maps all live outside
  // this block (emitted from R above, and by each table's own script), so the
  // panel_hit renderer can use the same logic before this runs.
  const state = window.svPanelState;

  $.fn.dataTable.ext.search.push(function (settings, searchData, index, rowData) {
    const node = settings.nTable;
    if (node !== window.snvTableElem && node !== window.svTableElem) return true;
    // No panel ticked is the unfiltered state.
    if (!state.panels || !state.panels.length) return true;

    // rowData carries the original (typed) values; searchData is the rendered
    // strings, and breakend positions have to be compared as numbers.
    const row = rowData || searchData;

    if (node === window.snvTableElem) {
      const cols = window.SNV_COLS || {};
      const idx  = cols["symbol"] !== undefined ? cols["symbol"] : 0;
      return window.snvPanelHit(row[idx]);
    }
    return window.svPanelHits(row, window.SV_COLS).length > 0;
  });

  function parseCustomGenes(text) {
    return new Set(
      text.split(/[\s,\n]+/).map(g => g.trim().toUpperCase()).filter(g => g.length > 0)
    );
  }

  function updateCount() {
    const parts = [];
    if (window.snvTableElem) {
      const n = $(window.snvTableElem).DataTable().rows({ search: "applied" }).count();
      parts.push(n + " small variant" + (n === 1 ? "" : "s"));
    }
    if (window.svTableElem) {
      const n = $(window.svTableElem).DataTable().rows({ search: "applied" }).count();
      parts.push(n + " SV" + (n === 1 ? "" : "s"));
    }
    const el = document.getElementById("panel-variant-count");
    if (el) el.textContent = parts.length ? parts.join(" · ") + " shown" : "";
  }

  // Which panels are ticked, in the order they appear in the chip row.
  function readCheckboxes() {
    return $(".panel-checkbox:checked").map(function () { return this.value; }).get();
  }

  // Chip appearance and the custom textarea follow the checkboxes, not the other way
  // round, so the load-time `checked` attributes and a Clear both land in one place.
  function syncControls() {
    $(".panel-checkbox").each(function () {
      $(this).closest(".panel-toggle").toggleClass("is-on", this.checked);
    });
    $("#custom-gene-panel").toggle(state.panels.indexOf("__custom__") >= 0);
    if (window.updatePanelNotes) window.updatePanelNotes();
  }

  function redraw() {
    if (window.snvTableElem) $(window.snvTableElem).DataTable().draw();
    if (window.svTableElem)  $(window.svTableElem).DataTable().draw();
    updateCount();
    // The breakend circos follows whatever the SV table is showing. Its own draw.dt
    // handler covers the per-column search boxes; this call is what paints it the first
    // time, before any filter has been touched.
    if (window.bndSyncFilter) window.bndSyncFilter();
  }

  $(document).ready(function () {
    // The count follows any draw of either table, not just a panel change. The per-column
    // search boxes and the tickbox dropdowns redraw directly — exactly as the breakend
    // circos's own draw.dt handler in _sv.qmd already assumes — so before this, typing in a
    // column filter left "N small variants shown" stale. It also means facet_filter.js
    // needs no coupling to this block: it calls draw(), and the count and the circos follow.
    $(document).on("draw.dt", function (e) {
      if (e.target === window.snvTableElem || e.target === window.svTableElem) updateCount();
    });

    $(".panel-checkbox").on("change", function () {
      state.panels = readCheckboxes();
      syncControls();
      redraw();
    });

    $("#panel-clear").on("click", function () {
      $(".panel-checkbox").prop("checked", false);
      state.panels = [];
      syncControls();
      redraw();
    });

    // The boxes carry their load-time state as `checked` attributes; adopt it rather
    // than assuming DEFAULT_PANELS and the rendered chips agree.
    state.panels = readCheckboxes();
    syncControls();

    let debounceTimer;
    $("#custom-gene-input").on("input", function () {
      clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
      debounceTimer = setTimeout(function () {
        state.customGenes = parseCustomGenes(document.getElementById("custom-gene-input").value);
        redraw();
      }, 300);
    });

    let _waitAttempts = 0;
    const waitForTables = setInterval(function () {
      if (window.snvTableElem || window.svTableElem) {
        clearInterval(waitForTables);
        redraw();
      } else if (++_waitAttempts > 100) {
        clearInterval(waitForTables);
      }
    }, 100);
  });
})();
</script>
```

```{r facet-filter-js, results='asis'}
# Checkbox-dropdown ("tickbox") column filters for the two big tables. Inlined once, at the
# end, from its own .js file rather than pasted into an R string — same reason as
# bnd_circos.js: it stays lintable JavaScript, and the report is self-contained so it
# cannot be linked. Each table's values (window.SNV_FACETS / window.SV_FACETS) and column
# map are emitted by its own prepare chunk above; the widget reads them when a table
# announces itself, so this only has to be parsed before the tables initialise.
cat("<script>\n")
cat(readLines(file.path(params$repo_dir, "assets/js/facet_filter.js")), sep = "\n")
cat("\n</script>\n")
```
